This 2-day course will introduce participants to common ML algorithms and how to apply them to omics data in extensive practical sessions. The practical sessions will be conducted in Python3 based on the widely applied scikit-learn ML framework. The course will comprise a number of hands-on exercises and challenges where the participants will acquire a first understanding of the standard ML methods and processes, as well as the practical skills in applying them to real world problems using publicly available biological or medical data sets.

Google's annual developer conference will have AI and Android 17 updates taking center stage.
[...]
Google I/O 2026 takes place May 19-20 at Shoreline Amphitheatre in Mountain View, Calif., with livestreaming available at io.google. The annual developer conference focuses on advancements in artificial intelligence, including updates to Google's Gemini AI models, Android 17, Chrome, Cloud and other Google products.
[...]
The event features keynote addresses from Google leaders, fireside chats, product demos, technical sessions, workshops and panel discussions. It serves as a platform for developers and technology professionals to learn about Google's technological roadmap and upcoming innovations, with a strong emphasis on AI at work and software development.
[...]
## Google I/O 2026 Focus Areas
[...]
- Artificial Intelligence: Latest breakthroughs and updates in Google's Gemini AI models and AI integration across products
- Android Development: Announcements and updates related to Android 17 and developer tools
- Cloud Computing: Innovations and tools in Google Cloud services relevant to developers and enterprises
- Agentic Coding: Advances in AI-assisted coding tools and productivity tools for developers
- Product Demos and Technical Sessions: Hands-on demonstrations and deep dives into Google's platforms and APIs
[...]
## Who Should Attend Google I/O 2026
[...]
The conference targets technical professionals and business leaders working with Google technologies:
[...]
- Software developers interested in AI and Android development
- Enterprise IT leaders focusing on AI integration and cloud technologies
- Technology product managers and strategists
- Startups and independent developers working with Google platforms and APIs
